name: cGZRect intersection (ret 8, thiscall on the output): `*this` = a & b when they overlap strictly (true), else all zero (false)
notes: Lane 261108s. Hooked at its RVA (adapter cGZRectAdapters::Intersect); our callers (cGZDrawContext, cGZDrawContextRenderToHardware, the dynamic strategy's MarkRecords and UpdateDirtyRects) call GZRectIntersect. Difftest SG_GZRectIntersect (400000 cases: rectangles built to touch, overlap by one, nest and invert, edges at the int32 extremes and random ones, each argument order; the result into a separate rectangle (canary words or zeroes) or into either input; noted: the answer's low byte, all three rectangles and the canaries around them; at least 10000 each of overlapping, apart and touching required). Mutants: 6 of 6 killed (touching x counted (>=), touching y counted (<=), right as the max, the miss leaving left, compared unsigned, and in the strategy's set the strict one in place of the inclusive one, killed by SG_DynamicDrawPaths).
